findings.evidence: `TauCeti/Probability/Exchangeability/Basic.lean:200` has `theorem measurable_reindex (φ : ℕ → ℕ) : Measurable (fun x : ℕ → α => fun k => x (φ k))`, while `ExchangeableSigma.lean:29` defines `abbrev permReindex (π : Equiv.Perm ℕ) ... := fun n => x (π n)`.
findings.fix: Delete it and use `measurable_reindex (α := α) (π : ℕ → ℕ)` directly; `permReindex π` is definitionally `fun x k => x (π k)`.
findings.issue: `measurable_permReindex` duplicates the existing ambient measurability lemma for arbitrary reindexing.

findings.evidence: `TauCeti/Probability/Exchangeability/Basic.lean:205` has `theorem map_reindex_pathLaw ... (φ : ℕ → ℕ) : (pathLaw μ X).map (fun x k => x (φ k)) = pathLaw μ (fun k ω => X (φ k) ω)`, which is the same statement after unfolding `permReindex`.
findings.fix: Delete it and use `map_reindex_pathLaw μ hX (π : ℕ → ℕ)` directly at call sites.
findings.issue: `map_permReindex_pathLaw` duplicates the existing path-law reindexing theorem specialized to a permutation.

summary: The PR adds public declarations that are direct specializations of existing TauCeti reindexing API under the `permReindex` abbrev.
